description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to Diffie-Hellman parameters, including predefined prime constants for various RFC 3526 primes, and functions for generating and copying DH parameters.

methods.name: get_params
methods.description: Helper function to initialize a BIGNUM from an array of words.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_1536
methods.description: Returns the 1536-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_2048
methods.description: Returns the 2048-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_3072
methods.description: Returns the 3072-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_4096
methods.description: Returns the 4096-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_6144
methods.description: Returns the 6144-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_rfc3526_prime_8192
methods.description: Returns the 8192-bit RFC 3526 prime as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: DH_generate_parameters_ex
methods.description: Generates Diffie-Hellman parameters with specified prime size and generator.
